verdict.rationale: Bento documents generic connectivity (Send-webhook workflow actions, first-party SDKs for JS/Ruby/PHP/Laravel/WordPress/WooCommerce/Next.js, and a ClickFunnels integration) that let ops teams wire external systems, but there is no evidence of maintained first-party integrations for Stripe, Shopify, or a CDP like Segment — the exact examples in the story. missing for 10: Stripe integration, Shopify integration, Segment/CDP integration, direct product-database connector.
